---
title: "Part 3: Functions and Variables"
author: "Sonny Xu"
---
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)

Exercise - Using functions
```{r}
round(3.14159)
```
Exercise - Argument order
```{r}
print(rep(5, 7))

print(rep(x = 5, times = 7))
```
Exercise - Character, numerical and logical variables
```{r}
x <- "word"
y <- 361
z <- TRUE

print(paste(x, y, z))
print(paste(class(x), class(y), class(z)))
```
Exercise - Using variables of different types
```{r}
cell_id_1 <- "CX1"
cell_id_2 <- "CX2"

treated_1 <- TRUE
treated_2 <- FALSE

before_1 <- 5415
before_2 <- 8123

after_1 <- 1432
after_2 <- 7543
```

```{r}
print(TRUE + TRUE)
print(TRUE + FALSE)
print(5 + TRUE)

x <- NA
print(x == NA)
print(is.na(x))

x <- 0 / 0
print(x)
print(is.na(x))
print(is.nan(x))

print(round(2.5))
print(round(3.5))
```

Exercise - Vectors
```{r}
cell_id <- c(cell_id_1, cell_id_2)
treated <- c(treated_1, treated_2)
before <- c(before_1, before_2)
after <- c(after_1, after_2)
```
Exercise - Indexing
```{r}
all_my_pets <- c("dog", "horse", "guinea pig", "chicken", "cat")
fourth <- (all_my_pets[4])
print(fourth)
```
Exercise - Creating a data frame
```{r}
my_data_frame <- tibble(
  cell_ID = cell_id,
  treated = treated,
  num_cells_before = before,
  num_cells_after = after
)

gt(my_data_frame)
```
